study type: Observational study with retrospective analysis of specific subgroups
exposure: foetal membrane retention status (retained vs. not retained)
outcome: presence and molecular weights of COL1 and COL4
cohort: Placental samples were collected from pregnant cows (2nd, 4th, and 6th month of gestation) and parturient cows after caesarean section.
finding: The study found significant differences in COL1 concentrations across pregnancy stages and between retained and released foetal membranes, with both COL1 and COL4 values being lower in retained membranes compared to released ones, and COL4 concentrations higher in the foetal part of the placenta.
cross-section timing: 2nd, 4th, and 6th month of pregnancy; and during parturition after caesarean section
gest_age: 2nd, 4th, and 6th month of pregnancy; and full term (parturition)
